stem: A child has lost a permanent tooth after trauma, and several options are available, including decoronation. Which approach to treatment planning is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: The clinician selects the definitive option alone without discussing alternatives
The choice is made through a full discussion with the child and parents, aiming to keep all options open until maturity
The option that closes off future choices earliest is selected to avoid delay
Discussion with the family is deferred until the time of implant treatment
